I have led numerous cross-departmental technical upgrades, resolving core hardware validation bottlenecks by establishing standardized development specs and automated error-proofing mechanisms.

I believe that great architecture should not only handle high traffic but also integrate seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines to significantly accelerate the R&D cycle.
